page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.48xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by AMD EPYC 9T24 processors running at 2.7 GHz. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs and 768.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers for distributed environments. From a resource density perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and large-scale core count offer high compute density, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for workloads requiring massive parallel processing without the overhead of local storage maintenance.

Given its balanced resource distribution and high core count, the ecs.g8a.48xlarge is suited for enterprise-grade general-purpose workloads. These include large-scale web serving, containerized microservices, distributed application backends, and medium-scale database hosting where external block storage is utilized.
